note: Fits the starting-point half of the ICP cleanly and misses the occupation half. He is emphatically not deconditioned or gym-averse — trains a couple of times a week with kettlebells and a jump rope, holds ~195 lb after losing 40-50 lb eight years ago and keeping it off, does intermittent fasting and meal preps — and he frames the ask as good-to-great in almost the ICP's own language: 'I would love to exceed those expectations, for sure.' Health is the deprioritised area rather than a crisis: 'there's always going to be something going on with work... I don't want the fitness and my health to take the back seat.' He misses 'successful' as stated, though — a youth minister and working drummer is not a business owner, a physician or an equivalent. Income is deliberately left out of both arrays: money was never raised in the recorded 16 minutes, no financials were disclosed, and inferring affordability from his occupation would be invention. That single unassessed criterion is what separates an edge call from a confident one here.
